verses.en: man is in a state of loss indeed,

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡحَقِّ ࣢ۙ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِࣖ‏
verses.en: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, and exhorted each other to follow truth, and exhorted each other to observe patience.
